en: I am an undergraduate in the Department of Automation at Tsinghua University, in the Talent Program for Intelligent Robotics. My research interests lie in world models for embodied systems, robotics, and representation learning.

I work on learning models that connect visual observations with actions and preserve spatial consistency over time. My projects span controllable video generation, multi-source representation alignment, and compositional 3D scene reconstruction.

I have worked with Prof. Yong Li at FIBLAB and Prof. Yueqi Duan at the Tsinghua Spatial Intelligence & Vision Group. I am currently an R&D intern at Shanghai Coco Matrix Intelligent Technology, working on robotic model pre-training.
zh: 我是清华大学自动化系本科生，参加智能机器人英才班。我的研究兴趣包括具身系统中的世界模型、机器人与表征学习。
我关注如何让模型建立视觉观测与动作之间的联系，并在时间维度上保持空间一致性。目前的研究涉及可控视频生成、多源表征对齐，以及组合式三维场景重建。
我曾在 FIBLAB 跟随李勇教授开展研究，也曾在清华大学空间智能与视觉研究组跟随段岳奇教授开展研究。目前在 Shanghai Coco Matrix Intelligent Technology 担任研发实习生，参与机器人模型预训练。
